must_fail_because: Generated imagery cannot have geometry or dimensions authority.
Generated imagery cannot be the basis of measured or verified geometry.
Verified records need reviewer, timestamp, method, and evidence source IDs.
Use ft for international feet or ft-us-survey; ambiguous feet is rejected.
Local coordinate reference requires an origin.
Verified scan geometry requires verified calibration and tolerance evidence.
Record verification cannot conceal unverified geometry.
Approved release requires approver, timestamp, evidence, and verified record.
Source references must match the registered snapshot hash.
Geometry basis must match a registered geometry-authoritative source kind.
Every property relationship must resolve to a property record.
A scan source claiming verified geometry/dimensions authority needs verified calibration.
Generated illustrations must remain unverified candidate visual guidance.
Actual geometry derivation inputs must equal measured geometry sources and carry geometry authority.
Verified geometry and its derivation cannot rely on an unverified scan source.
